events.description: Vessel arrived at Lagos pilot station anchorage.
NOR tendered Friday 1530 LT to Dangote Exports Ltd.
NOR accepted by charterers but laytime deferred per SSHEX.
All fast at Berth 8, Tin Can Island.
Saturday — SHEX terms, laytime not counting.
Sunday — SHEX terms, laytime not counting.
Monday — first working day. Laytime commences per SSHEX.
Stevedores on board. Hatches 1-5 opened. Loading commenced.
Nigerian National Day (observed) — SHEX terms, holiday excluded.
Holiday ended. Stevedores returned, loading resumed.
Last line let go. Vessel departed.

notes: WAFR loading with NOR Friday-after-1700 trigger. SSHEX defers laytime to Monday 0800. Plus public holiday exclusion (20h). Weekend excluded (48h). 28h day-1 + 31.5h day-3 = 59.5h net used vs 120h allowed.
